main_body: A tall dark column shaft (rows ~16-40) with three gold ring ornaments, a lighter left-edge highlight, and gray stone caps at the top (rows ~8-15) and bottom (rows ~41-47).
top_band: Top cap: gray, rows ~9-14, a lighter band about 2-3 rows at the top with a darker block on the right, drawn as a rounded rectangle block seen from the front. It reads as a capital face, not as an elliptical top surface. The shaft below has no visible top.
evidence: In the central column the cap is a flat gray band of about 3 rows with a dark outline, matching the guide's 'flat-band column cap' red example rather than the elliptical cap of the green column. The shaft is a flat dark front with rings painted on it and no horizontal surface. The bottom cap repeats the same band. No ellipse or top surface reads from above, so this is a front elevation with a hat.

style.evidence: The shaft is a large flat near-black fill with only a thin lighter edge strip and three flat yellow ring marks. The caps have 2-3 gray tones. The outline is near-black and neutral, producing a sticker look. There is no grain or speckle, and the tiles carry about 2-4 colours, far below the stall and well references, which have 5-6 shading steps and rich texture.
